data: In which scenario (plot) is the maximum Jaccard similarity among all methods at number of important features equal to 1 the highest?

The question asks for the scenario where the maximum Jaccard similarity among all methods at a number of important features equal to 1 is the highest. From the caption, we know that the similarity is not always greater when the two models agree on the predicted labels than when they disagree. This implies that the agreement between the models can affect the Jaccard similarity.

Looking at the graphs:

- In (a) Yelp, the built-in-agree line shows the highest Jaccard similarity at k=1 compared to other lines.
- In (b) SST, the LIME-agree line shows the highest Jaccard similarity at k=1 compared to other lines.
- In (c) Deception, the built-in-agree line shows the highest Jaccard similarity at k=1 compared to other lines.

Thus, the scenario where the maximum Jaccard similarity among all methods at a number of important features equal to 1 is the highest is in (a) Yelp.
